name: noel ~Shiroi Kisetsu o Anata to~
source:
Only 2 weeks left for Christmas day. To save her twin brother from repeating a year of school, she happens to pretend to be him and go to the school for a week. Can she have a happy merry Christmas??

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/girls/work/=/product_id/RJ019281.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
距离圣诞节只剩两周了。为了避免双胞胎弟弟留级，她冒充弟弟去学校上学一周。她能圣诞快乐吗？？

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/girls/work/=/product_id/RJ019281.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
